offence_note: Robbery by purse snatching with minor injury
sentence_quote: I would grant the extension of time within which to file the application for leave to appeal, grant leave to appeal, but would dismiss the appeal.
note: Judge said three years less about a year credit; appeal court calls it two years imposed.

offence_note: Sexual interference and invitation to sexual touching of daughter
sentence_quote: I sentence P.R.J. to a conditional sentence order of 23 months to be served in the community. That conditional sentence will be followed by a probation order of a further two years.
note: House arrest 12 months then curfew; live-in treatment only if directed; s.161 declined.

sentence_quote: In all the circumstances of this case, Mr. George will serve a term of imprisonment of four years. He is entitled to 188 days of credit for the time in custody awaiting bail.

offence_note: Sexual assault of incapacitated complainant (summary proceeding)
sentence_quote: I have however decided in this case not to impose the maximum sentence as suggested by the Crown but to impose a 14-month sentence of imprisonment in a Provincial institution to be followed by 2 years of probation.
note: Summary conviction appeal dismissed on conviction and sentence; Gladue considered but custody still required.

offence_note: Aggravated assault of police officer; disarming police officer
sentence_quote: He sentenced Mr. McCrae to six years' imprisonment for the aggravated assault and imposed a one-year consecutive sentence for disarming a police officer.
note: Only six-year sentence appealed; one-year consecutive sentence unchallenged, total seven years.

offence_note: Abduction of child, break and enter, possession of stolen property, mischief
sentence_quote: I make an order under s. 752.1(1) remanding Mr. Hopley into custody for sixty days for an assessment by experts.
note: Ruling on dangerous offender assessment order only.

sentence_quote: Leave to appeal sentence granted but the appeal is dismissed.
note: Life sentence inferred from second-degree murder; 14 years parole ineligibility upheld.

offence_note: Possession of hydromorphone for the purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: I am satisfied the joint recommendation of two years imprisonment is within the acceptable range and meets the purposes and principles of sentencing.
note: Court recommends institution allow continued drug treatment program.

offence_note: Assault with a weapon (van) causing serious injury
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal from sentence, and allow the appeal by substituting a sentence of three years’ incarceration for the offence of assault with a weapon (s. 267).
note: Forcible entry conviction quashed, new trial ordered; original sentence length not shown; mitigating from opening and positive pre-sentence report.

offence_note: Robberies, break and enter, hostage taking, weapon possession, assault peace officer
sentence_quote: On June 4, 2010, the appellant was designated a dangerous offender and sentenced to an indeterminate detention.

offence_note: Sexual interference, sexual assault of children, breach of s.161 order
sentence_quote: The sentencing judge sentenced the appellant to an indefinite period of incarceration.
note: Joint submission for determinate sentence rejected; indeterminate sentence upheld.
